title: Floating settings gear overlaps the opening decision on phone viewport
reproduction: Open a fresh campaign at a 390x844 mobile/touch viewport. On the opening Grey March modal, inspect the bottom 'Set out from Hearthwick.' action. The floating settings gear occupies the lower-right area of the same action button.
player_impact_summary: A secondary floating control competes with and partially obscures a primary decision, making the phone UI feel cramped and increasing accidental-tap risk.
notes: Already covered explicitly by LR-0009 acceptance criteria. Agent 5's parked PR #85 reports floating/safe-area overlap handling, but that work is not on current main yet; retest only after it merges.
